project_card_json.genre: 都市怪谈 / 恐怖惊悚悬疑
project_card_json.target_audience: 18-30 岁，偏女性向惊悚悬疑用户
project_card_json.core_conflict: 深夜门外出现和女主一模一样的人
project_card_json.ending_hook: 物业消息说门外根本没有人

characters.name: 沈知夏
characters.appearance: pale oval face, straight black hair, tired eyes
characters.inner_truth: 长期失眠，极度害怕深夜异常声音
characters.fear: 有人闯入她的私密空间
characters.secret: 她最近总梦到另一个自己站在门外
characters.stress_reaction: 呼吸变浅，动作僵住，先观察后行动

script_card_json.logline: 凌晨 2:44，独居插画师被敲门声惊醒，猫眼外站着一个和自己一模一样的女人。
script_card_json.audience_profile: 18-30 岁，偏女性向都市惊悚悬疑用户
script_card_json.audience_emotion: 紧张、压迫、不安、反转后发冷
script_card_json.core_hook: 门外的人长得和女主一模一样
script_card_json.opening_hook: 深夜敲门，手机时间显示 2:44
script_card_json.conflict: 开门确认真相还是继续躲在门后
script_card_json.escalation: 猫眼外的人不说话，只是盯着门内
script_card_json.fear_beat: 屋内安全感被门外敲击一点点打碎
script_card_json.suspense_beat: 走廊里只有敲门声，没有脚步声和呼吸声
script_card_json.misdirection_beat: 像是熟人求助，却越看越像不该存在的人
script_card_json.reveal_beat: 物业消息提示门外监控里根本没有人
script_card_json.payoff_beat: 她意识到自己刚才一直在和不存在的东西对视
script_card_json.cliffhanger: 敲门声再次响起，而且离她更近
script_card_json.episode_theme: 熟悉的自我也可能成为最可怕的陌生人
script_card_json.emotional_curve: 困倦 -> 警觉 -> 恐惧升级 -> 认知崩塌
script_card_json.conflict_chain: 深夜异常 -> 观察确认 -> 身份错位 -> 规则提示 -> 现实反转
script_card_json.secret_reveal_plan: 先让观众相信门外真的有人，再通过监控信息推翻
script_card_json.next_episode_hook: 如果门外没有人，那第二次敲门声是谁发出的？

shots.core_action: 沈知夏被急促敲门声惊醒
shots.image_prompt: a young woman wakes up in a dim old apartment bedroom from urgent knocking, staring at a smartphone showing 2:44 a.m.
shots.video_prompt: she jolts awake, looks at the phone, then freezes toward the doorway
shots.bgm_prompt: low suspense drone with room tone
shots.editing_notes: Hold on the phone screen beat before she looks toward the door.
shots.image_prompt_intent: single-shot suspense keyframe with phone-time reveal
shots.storyboard_clarity: clear waking moment with readable fear
shots.composition: tight 9:16 frame with negative space toward the doorway
shots.lighting: low light with cold smartphone glow

shots.location: 公寓入户门 / 狭长走廊
shots.image_prompt: peephole view of a dim apartment corridor where a woman identical to the protagonist stands under yellow hallway light with a hollow expression
shots.video_prompt: use the uploaded image as first frame, subtle fisheye tension, the hallway woman barely moves while the viewer hesitates
shots.bgm_prompt: tighter suspense pulse with silence gaps
shots.subject_motion: natural blinking and almost no body motion
shots.editing_notes: Keep the corridor still so the face mismatch becomes the horror point.
shots.visual_focus: the identical face outside the door
shots.image_prompt_intent: disturbing reveal keyframe with corridor dread
shots.storyboard_clarity: clear peephole POV with identity shock
shots.composition: circular peephole framing with distorted corridor depth
shots.lighting: dim yellow corridor light with heavy shadow

shots.core_action: 沈知夏盯着物业消息僵住
shots.dialogue: 请不要开门，监控显示你门外没有人。
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a frightened woman staring at a phone message saying there is nobody outside while the dark door behind her feels threatening
shots.video_prompt: use the uploaded image as first frame, hold the frozen reaction, then let the second knock land as she cannot move
shots.bgm_prompt: sudden silence followed by a sharp low hit
shots.subtitle_text: 请不要开门，监控显示你门外没有人。
shots.editing_notes: Let the message land first, then hit the second knock after a suspenseful pause.
shots.conflict_beat: safe explanation vs impossible second knock
shots.visual_focus: phone message and dark door behind her
shots.image_prompt_intent: reversal cliffhanger keyframe with message contrast
shots.storyboard_clarity: clear contradiction between message and sound
shots.reference_priority: phone message first, then doorway threat
shots.composition: vertical close-up with phone foreground and door background
